messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: velvet-inc (customer: Velvet) — Dedicated pool 'velvet-prod-pool' experiencing elevated 5xx error rate >25% over 5m. Region: us-west-2. Pager: @oncall_jess. Impact: generation failures and latency spikes for tenant-specific endpoints.

oncall_jess: Oncall Jess: I'm taking this. P1. Jumping into bridge, paging SRE and Infra.

infra_ana: Ana (infra): Looking at metrics now. gRPC error stream shows TLS handshake failures between g-12 -> g-13 and a spike in mem.high events on g-13. Pulling syslogs.

devops_ryan: Ryan (devops): I'll start tenant isolation and move Velvet traffic to standby pool. Preparing drain commands.

devops_ryan: ```bash
# drain nodes in velvet-prod-pool and attach tenant to standby
rctl pool cordon velvet-prod-pool --nodes g-12,g-13
rctl pool drain velvet-prod-pool --tenant velvet-inc --grace 30s
rctl pool attach standby-velvet --tenant velvet-inc
```

eng_sre_noah: Noah (eng-sre): Observing KV cache saturation on g-13. TTLs not expiring fast enough, large prefix churn from one of Velvet's workloads. Rolling restart of affected workers to free cache.

customer_success_liam: Liam (cs): On bridge with Velvet. They report intermittent 500s on model.generate and higher latency on streaming. They're asking for ETA and whether their data was accessed. Reassuring them we're isolating and no cross-tenant data exposure suspected.

acct_mgr_maya: Maya (acct): I'll prepare a customer-facing note and coordinate credits once we have impact window. Keeping them informed.

vp_prod_erica: Erica (vp_prod): Keep updates short for execs. We need impact estimate and mitigation ETA.

incident-bot: Mitigation action started: traffic re-routing to standby-velvet; automated failover triggered. Error rate dropping to ~6% over the last 2 mins.

oncall_jess: Jess: Confirmed routing change; metrics look much better. Watching for any residual 5xxs.

devops_ryan: After draining g-13 and restarting workers, mem high events stopped. Log snippet shows large cache growth tied to prefix "velvet--session-*" due to a retry storm from the customer's client.

devops_ryan: ```
[2026-03-15T10:41:02Z] g-13 kernel: oom-killer invoked -> process serve_worker (pid 8421)
[2026-03-15T10:41:05Z] serve_worker: kv_cache_size=3.8GB, entries=1_200_000 (prefix=velvet--session-*)
[2026-03-15T10:41:12Z] serve_worker: restarting to reclaim memory
```

eng_sre_noah: Noah: Root cause hypothesis: client's retry pattern caused extreme KV cache retention; eviction policy didn't prioritize long-tail prefixes. Combined with a sticky assignment, one host hit OOM. Mitigation: tenant isolation + restart prevented cross-tenant impact.

infra_ana: Ana: Confirmed no cross-tenant errors in logs. Network/TLS looks fine, problem is local memory pressure. We'll backport cache eviction tuning to the dedicated runtime and add a guard to limit per-tenant cache usage.

customer_success_liam: Liam: Velvet accepted mitigation; asked for timeline for a permanent fix and credits. They've raised a support ticket for SLA adjustments.

acct_mgr_maya: Maya: Proposed customer comm draft: apology, timeline, what we did (isolation, failover), and what we're doing next (hotfix + monitoring). Suggested compensation: 15% invoice credit for the incident window + 3 months of 5k burst tokens. Waiting for legal sign-off.

vp_prod_erica: Erica: Draft for exec update (high level):
```
- Summary: Velvet experienced 5xxs due to tenant-specific KV cache storm causing OOM on one host in dedicated pool.
- Impact: 12% of Velvet requests failed (approx 7k failed requests) over a 22-minute window. No data leak.
- Mitigation: Isolated tenant, routed to standby pool, restarted affected nodes. Incident mitigated at T+18m.
- Next steps: Hotfix eviction policy, add per-tenant cache caps, rollout to dedicated pools in 48h. Customer credit proposal: 15%.
```

eng_sre_noah: Noah: RCA draft bullet points: detection via gRPC error alert; cause = per-tenant cache retention + retry storm; contributing factor = sticky assignment of cache shard to single node; immediate fix = tenant failover + restart; long term = eviction tuning, shard rebalancer, add automated tenant isolation when per-tenant mem > threshold.

oncall_jess: Jess: Marking incident as mitigated in PagerDuty and Slack. Leaving follow-ups as action items in postmortem.

acct_mgr_maya: Maya: I'll send the customer comm after legal + CSM review. Proposed credit approved by me provisionally; will confirm final amount after RCA.

infra_ana: Ana: Action items assigned: AN-1 (hotfix cache eviction) owner=noah due 48h; AN-2 (per-tenant mem cap) owner=ana due 72h; AN-3 (customer comm send) owner=maya due 6h.

customer_success_liam: Liam: Adding Velvet's support ticket ID: VEL-20260315-01 to the incident so it's linked.

vp_prod_erica: Erica: Thanks team. Please keep me posted if Velvet escalates to execs. I'll prep an internal exec note with the RCA once Noah's draft is ready.

eng_sre_noah: Noah: Posting RCA draft to docs and will ping Erica when ready. Quick patch submitted for eviction policy, running canary now in staging. :thumbsup:

oncall_jess: Jess: Great work. Closing bridge but leaving thread open for follow-ups and the customer comm draft. :pray:

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Severity P1 -> Postmortem.
